data.gender_notes: Asaalat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'as'alah' which means to ask, to request, or to beseech. This name is often given to girls as a reminder of the importance of prayer and supplication to Allah (swt). It is also a beautiful reminder of the peace and tranquility that comes from connecting with the divine. The name Asaalat carries the meaning “Prayer, supplication” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Asaalat usually hope their child will grow to embody prayer, supplication and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the spiritual journey of seeking closeness to Allah through prayer and supplication. It is a name that inspires a deep sense of faith, devotion, and connection to the divine.
data.etymology: Asaalat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prayer, supplication.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asaalat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
